jobs.description:
1 Principal AI Engineer Your Tasks
 * Being part of SQUER means driving solutions in client projects and actively shaping SQUER with your knowledge.
 * Lead our clients in their AI adoption, develop their AI vision and target picture, and translate both into a concrete, prioritised transformation roadmap.
 * You will support several teams by solving complex challenges of both frontend and backend development.
 * You will be responsible for introducing or improving the AI-usage in the SDLC across the engineering teams of our clients and successfully deliver software solutions together.
 * You can communicate openly and are a team player.
 * You are actively involved in all phases of software development in an interdisciplinary manner and are happy to share your knowledge with your colleagues as a sparring partner and coach.
 * You are an active member of mostly agile SCRUM teams and spread SQUER culture with the aim of constant improvement.

Your Qualifications
 * Your experience and big-picture-thinking allows you to create solutions that generate a sustainable impact for our clients. 
 * You are a rolemodel in the usage of AI-powered tools (e.g., code assistants, LLM-based workflows) to amplify your productivity and quality and you are proficient in guiding teams in their AI adoption.
 * You have several years of experience within software architecture, cloud-native development and containerization (Docker or Kubernetes). You would like to deepen your knowledge in this field.
 * You have solid knowledge of frontend and backend development and relevant trends within this area excite you.
 * You have a hands-on mentality and are proficient in one or more programming languages in the Java ( Java, Kotlin, Scala, Clojure, ...), Javascript (Javascript, Typescript) or cloud-native environment (Rust, Go, ...).
 * You continuously improve the AI-adoption along the entire SDLC, resolve bottlenecks and feel passionate about enabling software teams in all their disciplines.
 * Trainings and development of your skills are highly important to you. Moreover, you enjoy passing on acquired knowledge.
 * You are fluent in English and German (written and spoken) in order to communicate in the best way possible with colleagues and partners.

Your Benefits

 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration to suit your working style.
 * We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.
 * Be Part of a Thriving Team Culture: At SQUER, collaboration and connection are at the heart of what we do. Through open communication, shared successes, and meaningful team events - including our annual SQUER offsite - we cultivate a culture where everyone feels valued and inspired to grow together.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.

 
We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between € 95.000 and € 105.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.

Apply now:

>>> https://www.squer.io/jobs/principal-ai-eng...

ENPULSION GmbH is a Space Tech company based in Austria. Founded in 2016, it has quickly become a dominant player in the Space Industry selling one of the most advanced propulsion solutions for Small Sats to a large number of worldwide satellite platform integrators. The unique, modular solution we offer brings high performance at low cost to satellite manufacturers, fostering the democratization of space and enabling the exploration and exploitation of the solar system, positioning ENPULSION at the very heart of the New Space era.

We are currently seeking for a motivated employee for our Team, who will take over the duties and respons... 2 Production Employee (w/m/d) Job Overview:
ENPULSION is looking for a Production Employee (f/m/x) to join our Production team and support the assembly and production of satellite propulsion systems. This is a hands-on role where accuracy, reliability and quality are essential. You will work with small, high-precision components and follow clearly defined production processes.

The position is full-time and operates on a rotating two-shift schedule.

Key Responsibilities:

 * Assemble high-precision components according to work instructions
 * Carry out defined production processes and document production data
 * Prepare workstations, tools and equipment
 * Perform basic maintenance of laboratory equipment, including vacuum systems
 * Identify production issues and report deviations
 * Follow all quality and safety requirements
 * Support your colleagues and contribute to smooth daily production

Your profile:
 * Strong technical or manual interest (technical training in electronics, mechanics, or a comparable field is an advantage).
 * High attention to detail and excellent fine-motor skills.
 * Reliable, structured, and quality-focused way of working.
 * Ability to follow defined processes and instructions.
 * Good English skills are required.
 * Willingness to work in a rotating two-shift schedule.

Nice to have:

 * Experience working in a production, laboratory, or clean-room environment.
 * Technical training, such as a completed apprenticeship or HTL education, is helpful but not required.
 * Previous exposure to 2-shift operations.

Type of contract: 38.5 hours/week 

Salary: The minimum base salary for this position starts at EUR 2.727,40 gross per month, with a planned significant overpayment depending on your professional experience and qualifications.

Why us?
At ENPULSION, you'll join a young, international team united by a deep passion for space technology and innovation. We foster a friendly, open-minded work environment that encourages new ideas and rewards initiative. Our culture is fast-paced and growth-oriented - a place where your work will have a real impact, and where you can truly leave your mark.

Our benefits include: 

 * 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional compulsory paid days off
 * Choice between a KlimaTicket (Metropol region), a discounted parking space or cantina vouchers for on-site dining
 * Monthly team lunches and regular team-building events
 * Learning & development budget to support your continued growth
 * Firmenradl - Bike Leasing program
 * Office located at VIE Airport City with access to:
 ** FitFabrik Fitness Center
 ** Airport Health Center
 ** Shops, restaurants, and Crew Shop discounts
 ** VIE Community App for news and deals

Please submit your application via this link:

https://www.enpulsion.com/careers/position/2448808/

We're excited to get to know you!

ENPULSION strongly believes in equal opportunities for everyone and supports diversity and inclusion. We're encouraging applicants with diverse backgrounds to apply. All applications are processed without regard to gender, nationality, race, color, religion, age, disability status, sexual orientation or marital status. OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We bring insights to the world's largest asset class that it never had before - both for new developments and existing portfolios. Our AI Hans delivers instant, deep engineering insight into costs, risks and optimization potential, grounded in building physics, simulation and engineering. Backed by international investors and a team of ~25 people from around 10 nations. Become a part of it! 1 Product Manager - Construction & Real Estate (PropTech) (m/f/d) Job description

We're now looking for a Product Manager with experience in the construction industry to take our platform to the next level- owning the roadmap, pricing, and scope along the way. Not managing. Shaping.

Your mission

 * The roadmap across all product areas. You decide what ships next - and you stand behind the why.

 * The path from prototype to platform. You sequence the porting effort in waves, cut scope where it's needed, and keep the codebases together instead of letting them drift apart.

 * Pricing and packaging. You align packaging with sales, keep the unit economics of compute-intensive simulation runs healthy, and own the Stripe catalog end-to-end.

 * Discovery and delivery with customers. You run pilot projects, sit down with asset managers and engineers, translate what you hear into specs, and make sure the platform's reports and studies hold up with customers.

 * Quality standards for simulation results. Engineers have to trust the numbers. You define, per engine, what "good enough to ship" means, and you manage the trade-off between physical accuracy and product speed.

 * The written trail. PRDs, a well-maintained decision log, release notes. Our rule: if it isn't documented, it didn't happen.

Your profile

 * Product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment - with substantial time spent on a technical or data-intensive product.

 * Experience in - or hands-on exposure to - the construction industry.

 * An AI-native way of working: for you, AI is a tool, not a buzzword.

 * Real technical confidence. You question a data model, follow a discussion with engineers, and understand a simulation output well enough to challenge it.

 * A degree that connects building energy systems, simulation, and building operations across engineering disciplines - or equivalent hands-on competence in building analysis and simulation

 * Fluent English; professional German strongly preferred.

Why us?

 * Real impact. Your product decisions feed into real investment decisions and move the platform forward in tangible ways.

 * The full solution chain. From digital twin to performance monitoring - a complete product portfolio rather than isolated one-off projects.

 * Flexible working models. Home-office option & a modern office in the heart of Vienna.

 * And the day-to-day works too. Daily meal allowance (€5/day), regular team events, free snacks.

 * Compensation: €60,000.00 - €80,000.00 gross/year.

Apply for this job
